items.q: What is an LLC?
items.a: A limited liability company (LLC) is a business entity created by filing Articles of Organization with the state. Owners should consult an attorney or CPA about liability and tax treatment for their situation.

items.q: Does Diler Services form Florida LLCs for owners outside Florida?
items.a: Yes. Diler Services forms Florida LLCs for business owners in every state. Each LLC must maintain a Florida registered agent, which Diler Services provides.

items.q: How long does it take to form a Florida LLC?
items.a: Diler Services submits the filing within 1 business day of receiving complete information. The State of Florida processes filings in the order received and sends a confirmation once the filing is approved.

items.q: What is included in LLC formation?
items.a: LLC formation includes preparation of the Articles of Organization, filing with the State of Florida, payment of the state fee at cost, and delivery of the state confirmation.

items.q: What information is required to start?
items.a: Diler Services requires the proposed company name, the names and addresses of the members or managers, a mailing address, and a contact email. A checklist is provided with each order.

items.q: What does a registered agent do?
items.a: A registered agent receives legal process, notices and demands on behalf of the company and forwards them to the company. Florida law requires every LLC to maintain a registered agent and registered office in Florida.

items.q: Who can serve as a registered agent in Florida?
items.a: Under section 605.0113 of the Florida Statutes, the agent must be a Florida resident or an authorized business entity whose business address is the registered office address in Florida.

items.q: Does Diler Services forward mail?
items.a: Yes. Registered agent clients receive same-day forwarding of documents received on behalf of their company.

items.q: How much is registered agent service?
items.a: Registered agent service is $13.99 per month or $169 per year.

items.q: What is an EIN?
items.a: An Employer Identification Number (EIN) is a federal tax identification number issued by the IRS. The IRS issues EINs free of charge. Diler Services charges a $95 service fee to prepare and submit the application.

items.q: When should an LLC apply for an EIN?
items.a: The IRS advises forming the entity with the state before applying for an EIN. Diler Services files the EIN application after the state approves the LLC.

items.q: When is the Florida annual report due?
items.a: Every Florida LLC must file an annual report each year between January 1 and May 1. The State of Florida assesses a $400 late fee on LLC reports filed after May 1.

items.q: What happens if the annual report is not filed?
items.a: The State of Florida administratively dissolves entities that have not filed by the third Friday of September. A dissolved company may apply for reinstatement. Diler Services prepares reinstatements for $299 plus the state fees at cost.

items.q: How much does it cost to form a Florida LLC?
items.a: LLC formation is a $89 service fee plus the $125 Florida state fee, passed through at cost. The formation bundle with EIN filing totals $299.

items.q: What do the other services cost?
items.a: Annual report $99 ($149 if filed late), DBA $129, amendments $99 and reinstatement $299, each plus the state fee at cost.

items.q: What is the refund guarantee?
items.a: If Diler Services does not submit the filing within 1 business day of receiving complete information, the $89 formation service fee is refunded. State fees are not refundable once filed.

items.q: What happens if the state rejects the business name?
items.a: If the State of Florida rejects the requested name, Diler Services refiles with a new name at no additional service fee.

items.q: Is Diler Services a law firm?
items.a: No. Diler Services LLC is not a law firm and does not give legal or tax advice. Legal and tax questions are referred to a licensed attorney or CPA.

items.q: How can I contact Diler Services?
items.a: Diler Services responds to inquiries by email at info@toromovers.com and through the request form on the Contact page.

items.q: What languages does Diler Services support?
items.a: Service is available in English and Spanish.
